title: 10 Homeleigh,  Proterstown, Castleknock, Dublin 15, D15DY9P
description:
- Exceptional 5 Bedroom Estate Family Residence With Significant Future Potential In One Of Dublin's Most Sought After Addresses

-Situated on c.1 Acre of Private Mature Gounds With South Facing Rear Garden

-Located Within A Secure Cul-De-Sac Enclave Of Only 20 Magnificent Custom Designed Estate Homes

-Located Between Two Excellent Golf Courses And Within A Protected Conservation Area

-Only a 25 Minute Drive to Dublin City Centre And Dublin Airport

Premium Collection are proud to present this magnificent 5 Bedroom Detached Estate Home in the exclusive private development of Homeleigh in prestigious Castleknock. Occupying a truly exceptional and secluded position at the end of the cul-de-sac, this home sits on c. 1 acre of mature grounds with a southerly aspect looking out over the Liffey Valley and toward the Dublin and Wicklow mountains. Positioned within a protected conservation area and between two excellent golf courses, Castleknock Golf Course and Luttrellstown Golf & Country Club, Homeleigh is highly convenient to Dublin City Center and Dublin Airport both being only a 25 minute drive away.

Upon entering through wrought iron electric gates, this 276sqm home immediately reveals its secluded, private and secure location being hidden behind large mature trees and at the end of the quiet cul-de-sac. A spacious entrance hall leads to a large formal living room with a magnificent Georgian Adam reproduction Carrera marble feature fireplace which flows through to a formal dining room conveniently located adjacent to the light, bright and spacious kitchen/breakfast room. Providing an abundance of shaker style cabinets, significant marble countertop space and a wonderful array of integrated kitchen appliances, this is a culinary enthusiasts delight and there is also a spacious utility room immediately adjacent, leading to a large double car garage. The downstairs also includes a large games room, a cozy family room and is completed by a downstairs bathroom and cloakroom.

Upstairs, a spacious landing provides excellent separation for all 5 bedrooms. The large master bedroom includes a light and bright shower room ensuite with bidet together with a spacious walk-in dressing room and an abundance of quality fitted wardrobes. The main bathroom is particularly spacious and includes a separate Jacuzzi bath and shower as well as a bidet and wonderful floor to ceiling tile. 

This home also provides excellent scope for enlargement to the rear and/or to the sides as well as vertically. It also provides ample space for a second detached residence (subject to planning permission).

Outside, the extensive mature grounds sit on c.1 acre and a wonderful array of mature trees hedges and flowers with private southerly aspect provides an appealing habitat for a wide variety of wildlife. This home has extensive red brick wall road frontage within the cul-de-sac and is accessed through magnificent electric wrought iron gates. The large garden and driveway at the front lead to two separate side entrances that flank the home. To the rear, which backs directly on to Castleknock Golf Course, the large extensive manicured lawn creates a sense of wide open space while ensuring privacy and quiet seclusion in a sun filled and sheltered setting. 

The immediate area is steeped in history with the Strawberry Beds, River Liffey Valley, Phoenix Park and Luttrellstown Castle all nearby, creating a rural ambiance so close to one of Europe's most vibrant cities. Ideal for family convenience being only a stone's throw from Castleknock Village, this wonderful estate home is within easy reach to every amenity with shops, bus routes, the nearby M50 and an excellent choice of prestigious schools like Castleknock College and Mount Sackville all in close proximity.

Viewing is highly recommended to get a true and full sense of the wide variety of wonderful features that this home has to offer.
